note: 'unknown power' means power IS NULL OR power = '*'. ConQuer's WHERE clause has no IS NULL/IS NOT NULL operator, so the NULL half can't be written as a plain comparison. The natural disjunction constructs (BUT NOT ... OR OTHERWISE ...) fail to compile as soon as the query also has the 'is of Legality' join ('cannot compile: node n10 has no anchor'). A correlated-subquery rewrite (THE COUNT OF Card [has CardUuid: !u] [has CardPower: '*'] > 0 OR THE COUNT OF Card [has CardUuid: !u] BUT NOT has CardPower > 0) does compile and its SQL (checked with --sql-only) looks correct, but it never finished executing against the 56,822-row Card table within the attempt/time budget, so I could not confirm the result rows and won't submit an unverified query.

Card has no fact type connecting it to Set anywhere in this model. Card only has CardSetCode (a value type) and Set only has SetCode (a different value type); no reading links them. Confirmed with ./try: 'is of' from Card is only ambiguous between ForeignDataHasUu, LegalityHasUu and RulingHasUu ('none of them reaches Set'). So a card's set, and that set's isForeignOnly flag, cannot be reached from Card in this model.
